name: cli-session-lifecycle-exclusivity
body:
`apg scan` and `apg project merge` run only with the session closed: with a live session each refuses and directs the caller to save and end first. The transient plan and review `.trans` writes run in the presence or absence of a session.

ACCEPTANCE:
- `apg scan` and `apg project merge` refuse while a session is live and state that the caller saves and ends the session first; with the session closed both run.
- `apg plan *` and `apg review *` transient writes run both while a session is live and while it is closed.
